items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: That’s what they called Jimmy Ford. Those recordings he made with Red Rodney at the Royal Roost

ctx.x: Yeah. So at the ripe old age of 15 I was playing with the “White Bird.” That’s what they called Jimmy Ford. Those recordings he made with Red Rodney at the Royal Roost, oh my God I’m going, I’m pinching myself.
Yeah you had the classic dream that most of us had at that age and it came true for you.
